remarks: OVER 1,700 SQ FT | 4 BEDROOMS | 3 FULL BATHS | MAIN FLOOR BED + BATH | DECK | DOUBLE DETACHED GARAGE |Welcome to this beautifully designed 2-storey home in Goodridge Corners, Edmonton, offering over 1,730 sq ft of thoughtfully planned living space on a regular lot.
